description: Reorder one custom property: place it just before or just after another (pass exactly one of before/after). Rewrites only the moved definition's rank. dry_run:true reports the new order without writing.

after.description: Place it just after this property.

before.description:
Place it just before this property. Pass exactly one of `before` and
`after`.

dry_run.description: Report the new order without writing.

name: move_property
